A press or a trigger toggles the state instead of holding it
Bogaudio-Manual: Manual gate — all eight outputs send +5V while the TRIG button is held, 0V otherwise
Menu — high voltage +10V instead; and a trigger pulse on patch load, the equivalent of a loadbang
Bogaudio-FourMan: Four independent manual gates, a button and an output each
An output sends +5V while its button is held, 0V otherwise
The high voltage and the trigger-on-load option apply to all four
Bogaudio-Mult: With nothing patched to the second section's input, it becomes one 1-to-6
Polyphonic inputs are duplicated with their channels intact
Bogaudio-Offset: Adds an offset to a signal and scales it
Menu — scale then offset, the default; or offset then scale
With nothing patched to IN the output is the offset on its own, so it doubles as a constant voltage source
Bogaudio-Slew: Slew limiter — when the input changes quickly, the output follows more slowly
The times, set independently, each calibrated as the time to catch up with a 10V change. CV 0-10V each
A second pair of knobs curves the two segments, between logarithmic, linear and exponential
Bogaudio-Sums: The sum, difference, maximum and minimum of its two inputs. An unpatched input counts as 0V
The negation of its own input
Output capped at 12V unless that is disabled on the menu
Bogaudio-Switch: While the button is held or GATE is high, each channel's HIGH input goes to its OUT; otherwise its LOW input does
A click or a trigger toggles the routing instead of holding it
Bogaudio-Lgsw: SWITCH with two gate inputs and logic between them
With one gate patched, or none, it behaves exactly as SWITCH
With both patched, the routing follows the logic over the two gates
The mode can be set by a 0-5V CV, which overrides the button
